# DATE surface qualification

The source and independently authored SQL declare and populate the same Table.
Dates cover the shared literal owner's endpoints, the Unix epoch and a leap day.
The compiled-case assertion checks exact typed dates and a separate nullable
column. Source unit/grammar cases cover symbolic domain operands, invalid dates,
foreign nominal IDs, rejected arithmetic and implicit timestamp conversion.

DATE source parameters and domains target ordinary SQL resources and queries.
Ordered program values and helpers remain rejected by the pinned Transit owner;
source type admission does not remove that boundary.
